dashboard.description: Actual fetcher run telemetry from the HEC ingest-log mirror (index=wearables_log)

{"title":"Ingest Health","description":"Actual fetcher run telemetry from the HEC ingest-log mirror (index=wearables_log)","defaults":{"dataSources":{"ds.search":{"options":{"queryParameters":{"latest":"$global_time.latest$","earliest":"$global_time.earliest$"}}}},"visualizations":{"global":{"showProgressBar":true}}},"inputs":{"input_global_trp":{"type":"input.timerange","options":{"token":"global_time","defaultValue":"-24h,now"},"title":"Time Range"}},"dataSources":{"ds_kpi_runs":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Runs (24h)","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest (msg="run complete" OR msg="run failed")
| stats count"}},"ds_kpi_failed":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Failed runs","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest msg="run failed"
| stats count as c
| eval color=if(c>0,"#E8503A","#4CAF50")"}},"ds_kpi_errors":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Errors (24h)","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest level=ERROR
| stats count as c
| eval color=if(c>0,"#E8503A","#4CAF50")"}},"ds_kpi_events":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Events delivered (24h)","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest msg="sent events"
| stats sum(count) as e
| fillnull e"}},"ds_users_attention":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Users needing attention","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest (msg="run complete" OR msg="run failed")
| stats latest(_time) as last latest(msg) as outcome latest(detail) as detail latest(error) as errtype by person_id comp
| where outcome="run failed"
| lookup wearable_person_profile person_id OUTPUT person_name
| eval Person=if(isnull(person_id) OR person_id="","(run-level / admin)", coalesce(person_name,person_id)." (".person_id.")")
| eval Since=strftime(last,"%m-%d %H:%M")
| sort Person comp
| table Person comp errtype detail Since
| rename comp as "Data source" errtype as Error detail as "What needs fixing" Since as "Failing since""}},"ds_users_attention_empty":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Users needing attention — empty state","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest (msg="run complete" OR msg="run failed")
| stats latest(msg) as outcome by person_id comp
| where outcome="run failed"
| stats count
| where count=0
| eval msg="All feeds healthy — no users need attention"
| table msg"}},"ds_feedstatus":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Feed status","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest (msg="run complete" OR msg="run failed")
| stats latest(_time) as last latest(msg) as outcome latest(duration_s) as dur latest(events) as events latest(skipped) as skipped by comp
| eval age_min=round((now()-last)/60,1)
| eval Status=case(outcome="run failed","FAILED", age_min>180,"STALE", true(),"OK")
| eval last=strftime(last,"%m-%d %H:%M")
| sort comp
| rename comp as Feed last as "Last run" age_min as "Age (min)" dur as "Dur (s)" events as Events skipped as Skipped
| table Feed Status "Last run" "Age (min)" "Dur (s)" Events Skipped"}},"ds_recentruns":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Recent runs","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest (msg="run started" OR msg="run complete" OR msg="run failed")
| sort - _time
| head 50
| eval Time=strftime(_time,"%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| table Time comp level msg events skipped duration_s detail
| rename comp as Feed level as Level msg as Event events as Events skipped as Skipped duration_s as "Dur (s)" detail as Detail"}},"ds_errors":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Errors & warnings","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest (level=ERROR OR level=WARN)
| sort - _time
| head 50
| lookup wearable_person_profile person_id OUTPUT person_name
| eval Time=strftime(_time,"%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), Person=if(isnull(person_id) OR person_id="","(run-level)",coalesce(person_name,person_id)." (".person_id.")")
| table Time comp Person level msg detail error file
| rename comp as Feed level as Level msg as Event detail as Detail error as Error file as File"}},"ds_errors_empty":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Errors & warnings — empty state","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest (level=ERROR OR level=WARN)
| stats count
| where count=0
| eval msg="No errors or warnings in range"
| table msg"}},"ds_throughput":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Events delivered / hour","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest msg="sent events"
| timechart span=1h sum(count) as events by comp"}},"ds_duration":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Run duration (s)","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest msg="run complete"
| timechart span=1h avg(duration_s) as dur by comp"}},"ds_coverage":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Coverage by person & source","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest (msg="run started" OR msg="run complete")
| stats count as log_runs latest(_time) as log_last by person_id comp
| append [ search `widx` | stats count as data_events latest(_time) as data_last by person_id vendor | rename vendor as comp ]
| append [ search `widx` earliest=-30d | stats latest(_time) as roster_last by person_id vendor | rename vendor as comp ]
| stats sum(log_runs) as log_runs max(log_last) as log_last sum(data_events) as data_events max(data_last) as data_last max(roster_last) as roster_last by person_id comp
| fillnull log_runs data_events value=0
| lookup wearable_person_profile person_id OUTPUT person_name
| eval Person=coalesce(person_name,person_id)
| eval Signal=case(data_events>0,"OK",log_runs>0,"quiet (ran, 0 new)",true(),"SILENT (no data)")
| eval last=coalesce(data_last,log_last,roster_last)
| eval "Last heard"=if(isnull(last),"-",strftime(last,"%m-%d %H:%M"))
| eval rank=case(Signal LIKE "SILENT%",0,Signal LIKE "quiet%",1,true(),2)
| sort rank Person comp
| table Person person_id comp Signal data_events log_runs "Last heard"
| rename comp as Source data_events as "Data events" log_runs as Runs"}}},"visualizations":{"kpi_runs":{"type":"splunk.singlevalue","title":"Runs
